events: Rajasthan Land Reforms and Resumption of Jagirs Act, 1952

needs_verification.statement_hi: कुम्भाणा सहित 34 गांवों की भूमि 1984-85 में महाजन फील्ड फायरिंग रेंज हेतु अधिगृहीत की गई।
needs_verification.statement_en: Kumbhana, along with 33 other villages, had its land acquired in 1984-85 for the Mahajan Field Firing Range.

evidence.text: करीब चार दशक पहले 34 गांवों को विस्थापित कर 3.37 लाख एकड़ के भूभाग में महाजन फील्ड फायरिंग रेंज को बनाया गया।

needs_verification.statement_hi: विस्थापन के बावजूद कुम्भाणा में होली पर होलिका दहन की परंपरा आज भी निभाई जाती है।
needs_verification.statement_en: Despite displacement, the tradition of burning Holika at Kumbhana continues every Holi, with former residents returning to the range.

evidence.text: होली पर्व पर कुम्भाणा में होलिका का दहन करने की परम्परा का निर्वहन होता है

needs_verification.statement_en: A community-shared list gives 32 of the 34 village names (unverified, single source)

needs_verification.statement_en: Kumbhana village was founded by Kumbha, eldest son of Nathu Dhatarwal.

evidence.text: Kumbhana was founded after Kumbha, the eldest son of Nathu Dhatarwal.

needs_verification.statement_hi: 1952 के भूमि सुधार अधिनियम से कुम्भाणा ठिकाने के जागीरदारी अधिकार समाप्त हुए।
needs_verification.statement_en: Kumbhana Thikana's jagirdari rights were abolished under the 1952 Rajasthan Land Reforms Act.

evidence.text: With the passing of the Rajasthan Land Reforms and Resumption of Jagirs Act in 1952, the feudal privileges, jagirdari rights, and administrative powers of Kumbhana Thikana were formally abolished.
